_comment: decades4.json plus two ways of being void, for -precon_ref_shift on voids. Materials 0 and 1 are decades4's (1 the 5x density-scaled copy of 0, so every group RATIO is the same in both). Material 2 is a void in EVERY group (Sigma_t = 0 throughout): it takes the same cells out of every group's support, so the groups still share one support and one reference, and the shifted pmat stays exact over the non-void cells and pure streaming over the void. Material 3 is transparent in the TOP group only (Sigma_t[0] = 0, and with it every scatter out of group 0 - a zero total admits none) and otherwise material 0: painting it gives group 0 a support the other three do not share, so RefShiftPmats puts group 0 in a class of its own, with its own reference, and never bins it with the rest. Shared by slab_decades4_void.json, box_decades4_void.json and plex_decades4_void.json.
